id.instruksi: Tanaman di rumah ingin berbunga. Dengarkan keadaannya hari ini, lalu pilih cara merawat yang tepat.
id.t-1: Tanah pot kering. Supaya tanaman bisa berbunga, apa yang dilakukan?
id.t-2: Pot ada di sudut kamar yang gelap. Apa yang dilakukan?
id.t-3: Pagi hari, waktunya merawat tanaman. Tanahnya kering. Pilih yang tepat.
id.t-4: Tanaman sudah disiram, tapi tidak pernah kena cahaya. Apa yang ia butuhkan?
id.t-5: Tanaman butuh air, tapi jangan terlalu banyak. Pilih yang tepat.
id.t-6: Daun tanaman pucat karena kurang cahaya. Apa yang dilakukan?
id.t-7: Tanaman di dalam kamar ingin berbunga. Ia butuh sinar matahari. Pilih yang tepat.
id.t-8: Hari ini panas dan tanah pot kering sekali. Apa yang dilakukan?
id.t-9: Mana cara merawat yang membantu tanaman berbunga?
id.t-10: Mana cara merawat yang memberi tanaman cahaya?
id.t-11: Tanah sudah basah, tapi pot masih di tempat gelap. Apa yang dilakukan?

en.instruksi: The plant at home wants to bloom. Listen to how it is today, then pick the right way to care for it.
en.i-terang: move it to a bright place
en.i-lupa: leave it without water for days
en.t-1: The soil in the pot is dry. So the plant can bloom, what do we do?
en.t-2: The pot is in a dark corner of the room. What do we do?
en.t-3: It is morning, time to care for the plant. The soil is dry. Pick the right one.
en.t-4: The plant has been watered but never gets light. What does it need?
en.t-5: The plant needs water, but not too much. Pick the right one.
en.t-6: The leaves are pale because of too little light. What do we do?
en.t-7: The plant in the bedroom wants to bloom. It needs sunlight. Pick the right one.
en.t-8: Today is hot and the soil is very dry. What do we do?
en.t-9: Which way of caring helps the plant bloom?
en.t-10: Which way of caring gives the plant light?
en.t-11: The soil is already wet, but the pot is still in a dark place. What do we do?

itemCount.keterangan: jumlah cara merawat per pertanyaan: 2 → 4; pengecoh = terlalu banyak air atau tanpa cahaya
